title: Nimbus Cartography Collective: A Brief History
text: The Nimbus Cartography Collective was founded in 2011 by four cartographers working out of a shared studio in Rotterdam. It began as a volunteer effort to map flood-prone neighbourhoods that commercial map providers had ignored. By 2019 the collective employed twelve people and had published atlases for three Dutch provinces.
